plan.major: Political Science (American Government, Law, and Politics Concentration)
plan.notes: Official CSUDH Academic Catalog 2025-2026, Political Science B.A. program page, 'American Government, Law, and Politics Concentration' 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid). GENUINE CATALOG ANOMALY: the source prints Total Hours 111, not 120. Semester sums: 15+16+9+15+12+15+15+14 = 111, which reconciles exactly with the printed 111. Two elective placeholder rows ('ELECTIVES TO MEET 120' in Second Year Fall and 'ELECTIVE TO MEET 120' in Third Year Fall) carry no printed unit value; the printed semester Hours (9 and 12) equal the sums of the concrete courses alone (3+3+3=9; 3+3+3+3=12), so these placeholder rows are sequenced at 0 units and the 111 total is kept verbatim, not 'corrected' to 120. 'American Government, Law, and Politics Concentration Course (see catalog)' rows modeled as choice slots referencing the concentration's catalog course list (POL 310, 312, 314, 325, 360, 361, 370). Spring of Fourth Year includes a genuine 2-unit 'Elective to meet 120 units' (3+3+3+3+2=14 as printed). POL 300 satisfies the GWAR requirement. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented.
